methods.name: Nuclear hashing with ssDNA oligos

methods.name: Consensus pseudodose trajectory construction
methods.protocol_description: HDAC inhibitor-treated and vehicle cells from three cell lines were aligned using a mutual-nearest neighbor (MNN) matching approach to produce a consensus HDAC inhibitor trajectory, termed pseudodose.

methods.name: Acetyl-CoA modulation experiment
